study type: Institution based retrospective follow up study
outcome: Time to recovery from respiratory distress syndrome
cohort: 386 preterm neonates with hyaline membrane disease admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit
finding: The median time to recovery of preterm neonates with respiratory distress syndrome was slower than the clinical recommendations, and factors such as multiple pregnancy, vaginal delivery, and neonatal hypothermia were significant predictors of time to recovery.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was found to be a significant predictor of slower time to recovery from RDS.
